description: Percentage calculations in three modes: percent_of (x percent of y), what_percent (x is what percent of y), percent_change (change from old to new). Use when the user needs a percent-of, what-percent or percent-change calculation with no financial product attached. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive percentage calculator.

x.description: For percent_of: the percent. For what_percent: the part.

y.description: For percent_of: the whole. For what_percent: the whole.

name: calculate_percentage

calculator_url.description: Deep link to the matching interactive calculator on everycalc.xyz.

results.description: The computed figures for this calculator.
